benchmark.name: PlotTwin-Bench
benchmark.paper: FigMirror: Ground It, Code It, Plot It
benchmark.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial; local evaluation only, no redistribution)
benchmark.task: given a reference figure + new tabular data, produce a figure in the reference's visual style
benchmark.reference_modality: raster image + matplotlib script (the script is shipped, the reference image is authoritative)
benchmark.official_scorer: plottwin_scorer: deterministic colour module (CIEDE2000) + VLM-based components; combined score requires a VLM, so local runs report deterministic metrics only

Std-band.note: band via lo/hi when the target data carries an interval

Bar.fallback: ranked_composition when only one measure exists

Scatter.fallback: log_scatter when both measures span orders of magnitude

Heatmap.note: style transfer can worsen it; see benchmark by_type

Field 2D.note: contour/field semantics not yet an operator; measured worse

3D.note: no 3D operator; 3D rarely survives Nature print, so tasks of this type are reported as classified failures, not attempts

coverage.note: 3D excluded by design; Network/Tree still lacks an operator
